product_one_liner.value: Lumilens develops optical/photonic interconnects—including pluggable, near-package, and co-packaged optics—that connect and scale AI data-center compute infrastructure for hyperscalers and other AI infrastructure operators.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage and company funding announcement describe its AI-infrastructure connectivity products.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer show no pricing link, and no public pricing page is identified.

named_customers.notes: The company describes a multi-billion-dollar agreement with an unnamed hyperscaler; the available announcement does not name a customer, so there are not two customer names to provide.

employee_band.notes: The company LinkedIn profile lists its company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists San Jose, California as headquarters; the company funding announcement is datelined San Jose, California.

founded_year.notes: The company's announcement says it was founded about two years before its 2026 emergence; PitchBook lists 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The blog/news index shows company, product, industry, and funding content, but not at least two documented engineering-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer provide no public product documentation, developer portal, or help-center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists openings, but available current listings do not have AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, applied-scientist, research-scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision titles.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed company site, privacy page, blog/news area, and public job board do not identify an AI model or model provider used by Lumilens's product.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed privacy page and footer do not publicly claim any of the specified certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS).

last_funding.notes: The company's August 2026 announcement reports more than $700 million in its latest financing; the round is identified as Series C. The amount is represented as $700 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series C funding was announced in August 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists open roles, but no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive title is shown.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 announcement states that Lumilens emerged from stealth and was shipping optical interconnect products into production hyperscaler AI data centers, a product launch within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page identifies current executives but does not establish when they joined or whether anyone departed during the 12-month period; no dated leadership-change announcement was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public openings and company pages reviewed did not establish a CRM or sales/marketing system in use; no readable source naming one was found.
